record.field: Competence in a limited range of relatively simple and standardized work activities, requiring limited theoretical knowledge and practical skills.
Competence in well-defined professional activities, using specific tools and techniques with some autonomy and requiring technical knowledge and an understanding of work processes.
Competence in professional activities requiring mastery of various techniques, autonomy, coordination and supervision, and an understanding of technical and scientific principles.

Competence in complex professional activities across varied contexts, combining technical, scientific, economic and organizational factors to plan and develop projects, processes, products or services.

Competence in highly complex professional activities, often in unpredictable contexts, requiring substantial autonomy and responsibility for resources, analysis, design, planning, execution and evaluation.
